changes: Cancel scheduled retries on abort or output stream destruction; ignore duplicate callbacks and stale stream events.
Settle with the last response or error when the retry budget expires; allow zero-delay asynchronous retries.
Validate finite nonnegative retry configuration, bound native timer intervals and measure retry budgets with a monotonic clock.
Forward response and completion only from the accepted stream attempt; preserve buffering and backpressure.
Snapshot supported own option fields directly, eliminating extend; supply structural declarations without @types/request.
Defer discarded transport teardown until its current response event finishes, avoiding teeny-request pipeline races.
Add explicit responseAfterEnd for gRPC transports that emit terminal status after readable end; preserve default HTTP early-end detection and abort cleanup.
